title: Laura Baskall-Smith MA CCC-SLP - Videos
description:
SLP Mommy of Apraxia is an account ran by speech/language pathologist, Laura Baskall Smith MA CCC-SLP.  If you're looking for information on childhood apraxia of speech (CAS), you've come to the right place! Want to learn more about CAS?  Check out the Uncorked playlist with specialists Cari Ebert and Laura.  Looking to hear stories of adults who grew up with CAS? Check out the zoom panels with adults playlist!  Want to see some tidbits of Laura's journey with her daugher Ashlynn who has CAS?  Check out the Ashlynn playlist!
Don't forget to subscribe so you don't miss anything!
